# Verification

How you checked it: the commands you ran, and the pages you looked at.

- [ ] `scripts/build.sh` succeeds for the target you touched
- [ ] the changed pages render in `dist/` or under `npm run dev`
- [ ] links and assets resolve at their deployed paths

Doc content lives in the lumen and candela repos, not here. A wording or page
fix belongs in the product repo; this repo holds the site and the build.
